title: Advanced
description: Connect NIVO to n8n, Make, Zapier or your own tools. For owners and managers.
forbiddenTitle: Only the owner and managers can open this page
forbiddenBody: This page holds keys that open your shop's data. Ask your owner if you need it.
eventsBody: When something happens in the shop (a new customer, a won deal, a payment), NIVO posts a signed message to the address you choose, so your tools can carry on from there.
keysBody: A key lets another tool read and write your shop's data. Make one key per tool so you can cut one off without breaking the others.
newKeyWarn: Shown only once. Save it now.
keysEmpty: No keys yet. Create one above when a tool needs it.
revokeAsk: Revoke "{name}"? Tools using it stop working right away.
guideIntro: Base address: {base}. Send the key in the Authorization header. Each key may make 60 requests a minute. An error answer has a code and a message.
leadsPostNote: Answers 202 with lead_id (the customer already known, or null for a new one) and status: accepted (received, being processed) or unchanged (this external_id was sent before).
messagesPost: Send a message to a customer
messagesPostNote: Use lead_id or conversation_id. The message goes through the owner's authority: when the rule is ask first, it waits as a decision in Office and is NOT sent directly. Answers 202 with conversation_id and status queued. The Idempotency-Key header keeps a retry from sending twice.
knowledgePostNote: visibility is internal or public. Answers 202 with an id; the knowledge is read and indexed within seconds.
pullNote: Pull-based option: ask for what happened since a time, as often as you like.
n8nTitle: In an n8n HTTP Request node
n8nSteps: Method POST. URL as above. Authentication: Generic Credential Type, then Header Auth with Name Authorization and Value Bearer nvk_... . Turn on Send Body, JSON.
keysRefused: You are not allowed to manage this shop's API keys.
createFailed: The key could not be created. The name needs at least 2 characters and a shop may have 20 active keys.
revokeFailed: This key could not be revoked. Try again.
sampleNeed: Asking the price of the 3 month plan
